subject: Post-demo: procurement options & security gating for Acme Health
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Post-demo: procurement options & security gating for Acme Health

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum on procurement readiness: 

Recap (30-min demo)
- Showed hosted API latency/cost profiles and Dedicated options for predictable throughput
- Discussed VPC/private plane for patient-data workflows and KMS integrations
- Walked through typical procurement routes: corporate card pilot, PO + invoice (legal + finance), and AWS Marketplace listing for consolidated billing

Primary gating items you called out:
1) SOC 2 report and DPA language — legal needs DPA redline and a SOC 2 summary before procurement will accept PO
2) Security questionnaire — InfoSec wants answers and a couple of evidentiary artifacts (audit logs retention, encryption keys)
3) Billing route — unsure if procurement will accept Marketplace or requires a PO with internal GL code

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- I’ll upload a short SOC 2 summary and our standard DPA redline to the shared Drive by EOD today. (attached to this thread)
- Neha will follow up with answers to the security questionnaire items flagged in the call (expect within 48 hours)
- Marissa will prepare a one-page commercial options matrix (card vs PO vs marketplace) for your finance team that lists pros/cons and typical lead times

Can you confirm which path procurement prefers for a pilot (card or PO) and whether Marketplace is on the table? If PO, what timeline does Finance need for approvals (rough weeks)?

I’ve attached: SOC2_summary.pdf, DPA_redline_v1.docx, Security_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx (draft).

Thanks — I’ll stand by for your preference and we’ll prioritize docs accordingly.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0112
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement options & security gating for Acme Health

Thanks Logan — good recap. A few clarifications from our side after we huddled with Finance and InfoSec: 

Finance (Shelly in procurement) says:
- For a pilot under $25k, a corporate card is easiest; anything above that needs a PO
- We prefer Marketplace only when there is a consumption-based forecast; otherwise Marketplace creates downstream reconciliation work for our ERP

InfoSec (Tom) asks:
- Can you confirm retention period for audit logs and whether logs are immutable?
- Which KMS do you integrate with (AWS KMS, GCP KMS)? We need key management details in the questionnaire
- Are there any subprocessor lists available?

Action items for you / Redwood: 
- Please confirm retention and immutability for logs and specify KMS options
- We’ll review the DPA redline and revert with comments; current procurement SLO is 2 weeks after DPA sign-off
- If we go PO route, need an estimated lead time and a sample invoice format

We are leaning toward a card pilot under the $25k threshold to move quickly, but want the SOC 2 summary and questionnaire answers before kick-off. Appreciate the attachments — reviewing now and will reply with DPA comments.

Best,
Priya
Head of Platform Integrations, Acme Health
priya.shah@acmehealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement options & security gating for Acme Health

Hi Priya / team — following up on the InfoSec questions. Inline answers below and attached a filled copy of the questionnaire for your records.

- Audit logs: retention configurable up to 3 years; default 90 days. Logs are write-once for the configured retention period (append-only) and we support export to your SIEM for long-term archiving.
- KMS: we support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys via AWS KMS CMKs for hosted/Dedicated; for VPC/on-prem we support HSM integrations (customer provides endpoint).
- Subprocessors: list included in the SOC2_summary.pdf (section 4) and attached subprocessor_list.csv

Attachments in this message: Security_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx (answers), subprocessor_list.csv (stub).

If you need a dedicated call with our security engineer to walk through the KMS/archival options, happy to schedule. Also noted the note about Marketplace reconciliation — Marissa will include that in the commercial matrix.

Thanks,
Neha
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com
